ModMetaData.name: Stick To Your Save
ModMetaData.author: CryptikLemur
ModMetaData.description:
Locks RimWorld to the colony you are already playing.
While the lock is active, the load screen only accepts saves from your current playthrough, and starting a new colony is blocked. The lock clears on its own when you win the game, lose the colony, or delete its save files.
Really sure you want out early? There is a main menu button that clears the lock, behind three confirmations. Disabling the mod asks three times too. You installed this for a reason.
Requires Concord.
